steps.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Generate a production creature portrait for dark gothic fantasy game Heroes of Orvesk. Single vertical 1024x1536 image, head and upper shoulders, three-quarter view looking toward IMAGE LEFT. Directional key light from ABOVE FRONT IMAGE LEFT; light must not be mirrored with pose. Deep charcoal near-black background. Sculptural three-dimensional modeling, aged bone and coarse worn fabric textures, fine grain like an old fantasy illustration, muted bone/graphite palette. Visually referenced style: weathered dense volume and restrained edge highlights from a bronze-armored portrait; gothic graphite angular forms; old ivory linen in deep shadow. Do NOT reproduce reference frames or characters. Anatomically convincing human skeletal skull, jaw, neck vertebrae and shoulder bones; genuinely dead and animated, no living flesh, not a masked person. Sinister quiet purpose, not comic. Bone fissures and deep empty eye sockets with no neon glow. Readable silhouette at small size. NO weapons, no shield, no bow, no arrows, no quiver, no hands, no armor, no text, no labels, no borders, no logos. Distinct character design. Subject: reanimated skeleton archer. Narrow elongated skull and long cheekbones, distinct missing upper canine, slight downward watchful tilt of head looking toward image left. Thin tattered dark grey burial-cloth hood, open around complete skull and jaw, no face covering; dark cloth frames the lighter skull and partly covers skeletal shoulders, small visible collarbones. Dry cool ivory bone, fine temple cracks. Identity distinct from broad bare-headed sentry. Do not communicate archer through a bow or quiver: this is a neutral equipment-independent portrait.
